topic: stop Excel from showing formulas instead of calculated values
core_question: How do I make Excel display results instead of the formula text in cells? (secondary: How do I waterproof leather boots before wearing them in wet weather?)
answer_summary: Toggle off the 'Show Formulas' view via the Formulas tab or the Ctrl+` shortcut so cells display calculated values instead of formula text.; after the topic shift: Clean and dry the boots, then work in a leather waterproofing wax (like mink oil or Sno-Seal) or apply a waterproofing spray evenly over the entire upper, letting it absorb before wearing.
